integrity: The lower bound is proved directly from the reversible spectral representation by Cauchy--Schwarz. Equality conditions are solved exactly, and explicit finite-state reversible chains realize every feasible two-lag pair at the global boundary. A recalibrated lazification proves sharpness in the aperiodic class. Exact-rational computation only replays these identities.
scientific_limitations: The result requires reversibility and uses the scalar spectral measure on the interval from minus one to one.
Two autocorrelations determine only a sharp lower envelope, not the full asymptotic variance.
For positive lag-two excess over the squared lag-one correlation, equality in the finite irreducible aperiodic class is not attained, only approached.
title: Two autocorrelations give the sharp reversible-chain variance floor
